title: Suspicious File Downloaded From Direct IP Via Certutil.EXE
text: Detects certutil.exe used with download flags to retrieve files. Peer-reviewed SigmaHQ rule (author Nasreddine Bencherchali, Nextron Systems). CRITICAL PATTERN: the selection anchors on BOTH Image|endswith '\certutil.exe' AND OriginalFileName 'CertUtil.exe' as an OR — so an on-disk rename cannot evade it because OriginalFileName is read from the PE metadata, not the on-disk path. CommandLine contains 'urlcache ', 'verifyctl ', or 'URL '. process_creation logsource, windows product, level high. Rename-resistant, high-fidelity LOLBin detection. tags attack.t1105 attack.t1027 command-and-control stealth.
